cards.name: Arc
cards.summary: Bends the whole selection into an arc: top and bottom edges both curve upward like a rainbow and the sides fan outward, as if the art were set on a circle; a negative Bend bows it downward instead.
use_for: arched headline over a logo or badge
rainbow-shaped lockup for posters and merch
curved banner text on stickers and labels
avoid: On wide art the top corners swing far outward (the shape becomes a ring segment); for type on an exact circle use Type on a Path instead.
The warp grows the bounding box: art that already sits near the artboard edge runs off it, so leave margin or scale the group down first.
Strong bends on small body copy make it unreadable; keep warps to short headlines, logos and badges.

Need to hand-tune the shape with a mesh? Use Object > Envelope Distort > Make with Warp (same styles, editable envelope) instead of the effect; use Object > Expand Appearance to bake the effect into real paths for export to apps that do not read live effects.

params.name: DeformStyle
params.does: Which warp shape the Adobe Deform live effect draws; 1 = Arc. The Effect > Warp items all apply this one effect and store different values only here and in the DisplayString label.

params.name: DeformValue
params.does: Bend: how strongly the shape is curved, stored as a fraction (0.5 = the dialog's 50%, inferred from the stored default; the harvest gives no range). The dialog's Bend slider also takes negative values, which flip the curve; the harvest did not probe them.
params.typical: 0.5 (stored default); go lower on wide layouts

params.name: DeformHoriz
params.does: Distortion Horizontal: adds a perspective taper, one side narrower than the other, on top of the warp; fraction, negative tapers the other way.

params.name: DeformVert
params.does: Distortion Vertical: tapers the top against the bottom, on top of the warp; fraction, negative tapers the other way.

params.name: Rotate
params.does: The dialog's Horizontal / Vertical orientation (probably true = Vertical): turns the warp 90 degrees so it runs down the height instead of across the width.

params.name: DisplayString
params.does: Label the Appearance panel shows; cosmetic. The harvest's applyEffect round trip sent the other 5 params and left this one out (values with spaces were not tested), so the scripted call omits it.

pairs_with: Object > Expand Appearance (bake into editable paths)
Object > Envelope Distort > Make with Warp (same styles as an editable envelope)
Effect > Distort & Transform > Transform (scale / move before or after the warp)
short bold type, badges and emblems

review.changes: summary gives the render's direction (left half dips, right half lifts); avoid dropped the invented 'use 0.2-0.4' and cites the measured ~58 px swing; demo Bend 0.3 -> 0.12: at 0.3 the plate group (1688 x 825, 75 px bottom / 116 px side margin) was estimated to drop the left half ~110 px below the artboard; common avoid removed: 'a uniform stroke thickens and thins along the curve' is contradicted by every harvest render (the 6 px stroke measures 6 px all round after the warp); DeformStyle 'does' no longer says the items differ only in DeformStyle (DisplayString differs too); DeformValue: 0.5 = 50% marked inferred, negative Bend marked unprobed, typical no longer an invented 0.2-0.5 range; DisplayString note now cites the batch (5 params sent) instead of an unbatched claim; Dict data Reals written 0.0 as verify_live.py sent them

cards.name: Inflate
cards.summary: Pushes all four sides outward at once with the corners held, so the art puffs up like a balloon or pillow; negative Bend sucks the sides in.
use_for: puffy balloon lettering
bubbly sticker or app-icon shapes
playful kids and party graphics
avoid: Grows the art on every side; for growth only top and bottom use Bulge, for a centre zoom use Fisheye.
The warp grows the bounding box: art that already sits near the artboard edge runs off it, so leave margin or scale the group down first.
Strong bends on small body copy make it unreadable; keep warps to short headlines, logos and badges.

Need to hand-tune the shape with a mesh? Use Object > Envelope Distort > Make with Warp (same styles, editable envelope) instead of the effect; use Object > Expand Appearance to bake the effect into real paths for export to apps that do not read live effects.

params.name: DeformStyle
params.does: Which warp shape the Adobe Deform live effect draws; 13 = Inflate. The Effect > Warp items all apply this one effect and store different values only here and in the DisplayString label.

params.name: DeformValue
params.does: Bend: how strongly the shape is curved, stored as a fraction (0.5 = the dialog's 50%, inferred from the stored default; the harvest gives no range). The dialog's Bend slider also takes negative values, which flip the curve; the harvest did not probe them.
params.typical: 0.5 (stored default); go lower on wide layouts

params.name: DeformHoriz
params.does: Distortion Horizontal: adds a perspective taper, one side narrower than the other, on top of the warp; fraction, negative tapers the other way.

params.name: DeformVert
params.does: Distortion Vertical: tapers the top against the bottom, on top of the warp; fraction, negative tapers the other way.

params.name: Rotate
params.does: The dialog's Horizontal / Vertical orientation (probably true = Vertical): turns the warp 90 degrees so it runs down the height instead of across the width.

params.name: DisplayString
params.does: Label the Appearance panel shows; cosmetic. The harvest's applyEffect round trip sent the other 5 params and left this one out (values with spaces were not tested), so the scripted call omits it.

pairs_with: Object > Expand Appearance (bake into editable paths)
Object > Envelope Distort > Make with Warp (same styles as an editable envelope)
Effect > Distort & Transform > Transform (scale / move before or after the warp)
short bold type, badges and emblems

cards.name: Rise
cards.summary: Shears the art along an S-curve so the left end drops while the right end stays where it was (at a positive Bend), the band rising across its width like an ascending swoosh while its edges stay parallel.
use_for: rising / growth headline for sale and sports posters
dynamic swoosh layout
ascending banner text
avoid: Strong: on the harvest's 300 x 200 probe at the 0.5 default the left end dropped about 206 px, a full height, while the right end stayed put (render check diff 20.7); keep the Bend low on wide layouts and leave room below the art.
The warp grows the bounding box: art that already sits near the artboard edge runs off it, so leave margin or scale the group down first.
